verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an in-product AI assistant that answers questions based on your notes and lets you pass blocks or notes as context in AI Chats. It can also plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for you to approve, and it adds AI property auto-fill and one-click image analysis. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted insights surfaced from your data (all documented AI is user-invoked), depth on what kinds of insights it produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
